title: FOREST-1 · Ewok Moonwalker
description: An Ewok-built walking lunar explorer in the blue, grey, transparent yellow and red language of 1979 Classic Space. Its bear-shaped hood is the flight deck; its ears are radar receivers, its paws are landing shoes, and its timber arms carry a sample scoop and a scanner spear. A twin-rocket backpack contains a furnished expedition cabin reached by a rear boarding stair.
